name: englobe-ams-server
description: Englobe AMS — local TypeScript API over PostgreSQL. Two drivers behind one interface: a networked pg Pool (docker-compose.yml, default) and the original in-process PGlite. Proof of concept; no cloud services.

scripts.db:reset: docker compose -f ../docker-compose.yml down -v && docker compose -f ../docker-compose.yml up -d --wait
scripts.test:both: npm run test:postgres && npm run test:pglite
